# CHOAM

> Culture must flow. CHOAM is an independent creative studio based in Seoul, South Korea, building video games, autonomous AI agents with long-horizon memory, and proprietary generative art tools.

## Studio Overview
- **Name**: CHOAM (초암)
- **Motto**: Culture must flow (문화는 흘러야 한다)
- **Location**: Seoul, South Korea
- **Established**: 2026
- **Website**: https://choam.studio
- **Contact**: mino@choam.studio

## Core Philosophy
CHOAM stands on four core principles:
1. **Culture Must Flow**: Culture is not static inventory; it breathes, evolves, and connects people across time and memory.
2. **Raw Over Fake**: We preserve authentic depth rather than sanitized superficial polish.
3. **Long-Horizon Memory**: Crafting intelligences and stories that retain what you said and carry it into tomorrow.
4. **Hands-On Prototyping**: We build tools to empower creators and forge worlds that endure.

## Flagship Projects

### 1. Scheherazade
- **Type**: Autonomous AI Agent Framework / System
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/scheherazade
- **Description**: An agent that stands for more than a thousand and one nights. Built with persistent long-horizon memory, multi-day self-healing, and emotional grounding across continuous operations.

### 2. DAT (Diffusion Architecture Transformer)
- **Type**: Proprietary Generative Art Model Architecture
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/dat
- **Description**: Our studio house aesthetic distilled into a dedicated generative model. Preserves authentic painterly brushwork, consistent anatomy, architectural perspective, and cinematic lighting across every frame.

### 3. 선잠 DOZE
- **Type**: Visual Novel Video Game
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam
- **Description**: A visual novel set in the local-history club of an old high school building. You speak to Yeji in your own words; she remembers what you said and carries your conversations into the next day. Over one week, small mysteries stop adding up.

### 4. Donguri Ryokan (동구리 료칸)
- **Type**: Narrative Simulation Video Game
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan
- **Description**: A seasonal story about running a quiet Japanese inn tucked into the mountain forest. Not every guest who arrives is human; spirits and travelers arrive with ancient memories and quiet requests.

### 5. Donguri Restaurant (동구리 레스토랑)
- **Type**: Culinary Simulation Video Game
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-restaurant
- **Description**: No fixed menu; the morning harvest decides what is served. A heartwarming cooking game about three companions preparing dishes at the edge of the forest.
